summary: Both independent v9 reviews found one in-scope P1: the design requires PYTHONHASHSEED but launches Python with -I (which ignores all PYTHON* variables) while bootstrap rejects it. A matching environment receipt could therefore describe a random effective hash seed. All prior graph, dispatch, ACL, runner-closure and replay-closure repairs were otherwise confirmed within the frozen scope.

limitations: Reviews were read-only and did not change product code, tests, contracts, gates, ledgers, or historical evidence.
No model training, replay, budget consumption, PIT certification, or final-OOS access occurred.

blockers: Test design, implementation, M7 freeze/fit, archival replay, CCC/Gate experiments, and final-OOS access remain prohibited until a corrected architecture/design passes independent review.
